claim: On sv10043 v26.40.8-7a95011 no screen opens the work order window in edit mode ("Edit Work Order"); the only openers create a new work order

positive_control.evidence: Same method opened the work order window from Create Work Order (title New Work Order, hc4/hc6 logs), opened Change Customer (its own window, hc17.log) and read Edit tech story / Change Asset buttons on the same page (hc16.log).

tried_through_the_screen.evidence: Work order page S10043-17594: every button read (Change Customer, Change Asset, Edit shop supplies charge, three-dots, Edit tech story, Labor fee) and clicked where relevant (hc16/hc17); regression helper walked the three-dots menu (Audit Log, Timesheets, Add Work Order Fee / Discount, Print Work Order, Delete Work Order), the status card and Change Customer (regression notes).

waited_and_retried.evidence: Two separate passes (regression helper and this check), each after a 6 s settle on the work order page.

checked_for_navigation.evidence: Each click read the overlay and URL; none navigated to an edit window; no new tab.

precondition_read_back.evidence: S10043-17594 exists, Approved with one line (hc7.log), and the Admin role holds Work orders Create & Edit (case preconditions; Admin can create and change work orders in this run).

searched_the_repo.evidence: git grep 'Edit Work Order' across build/: only this suite's case text and the regression notes; no recorded route. Also searched the build's own scripts: the window's title switches to Edit Work Order in edit mode, but the only two places that open it (Work Orders Create Work Order button, Schedule create) open it for a new work order (grep 'updateDialog",{which:"workOrder"' over the downloaded chunks: 2 callers).

asked_what_would_make_this_my_fault.evidence: Most likely mine: a hidden trigger (hover-only icon or a menu I did not open). Ruled out by the code search: no caller opens the window for an existing work order. Not ruled out: a part of the app not downloaded in my chunk set; the developer's note says Edit Work Order changed, so this goes to the QA lead as a question, not a defect.
